recommendations.title: Emergency eye care now
recommendations.message: Seek emergency eye care now. Do not drive yourself if your vision is suddenly impaired.

recommendations.title: Rinse and seek emergency care
recommendations.message: Immediately rinse the affected eye with plenty of clean water for at least 20 minutes, avoid rubbing it, and seek emergency care.

recommendations.title: Protect the injured eye
recommendations.message: Do not rub, press, or try to remove an embedded object. Seek emergency eye care now.

recommendations.title: Remove lenses and obtain urgent care
recommendations.message: Remove contact lenses, do not put them back in, and obtain same-day professional eye assessment.

recommendations.title: Same-day assessment
recommendations.message: Seek same-day assessment from an eye-care professional or urgent service.

recommendations.title: Prompt eye examination
recommendations.message: Arrange an eye examination promptly. Seek urgent help sooner if pain, sudden change, or worsening vision develops.

recommendations.title: Routine comprehensive eye examination
recommendations.message: Arrange a routine comprehensive eye examination to check vision and eye health.

recommendations.title: Reduce spread
recommendations.message: Wash hands often, avoid touching or rubbing the eyes, and do not share towels, eye cosmetics, or personal eye-care items.

recommendations.title: Gentle eyelid care
recommendations.message: Keep the eyelids clean and arrange assessment if the problem persists, becomes painful, or affects vision.

recommendations.title: Diabetes eye examination
recommendations.message: Arrange a comprehensive dilated eye examination and continue regular diabetes and eye-health reviews.
